name: gameshelf
description: Root task runner. Every script works from any shell (cmd, PowerShell, Git Bash, CI). Tests run in containers only.

scripts.setup: dotnet tool restore && dotnet restore GameShelf.sln && npm --prefix src/gameshelf-web ci --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up
scripts.dev:api: npm run db:up && dotnet run --project src/GameShelf.Api
scripts.build: dotnet build GameShelf.sln && npm --prefix src/gameshelf-web run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix src/gameshelf-web run lint && npm --prefix src/gameshelf-web run typecheck
scripts.test:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml --profile backend --profile frontend --profile e2e down --volumes --remove-orphans
scripts.bicep:build: az bicep build --file infra/bicep/main.bicep && az bicep build-params --file infra/bicep/env/dev.bicepparam
scripts.ci:local: npm run lint && npm test && npm run bicep:build
